@@ -426,3 +426,17 @@ def test_Piecewise():
     # trigsimp tries not to touch non-trig containing args
     assert trigsimp(Piecewise((e1, e3 < e2), (e3, True))) == \
         Piecewise((e1, e3 < s2), (e3, True))
+
+
+def test_sinc():
+    from sympy.functions.elementary.trigonometric import sinc
+    
+    k = symbols('k')
+    
+    # Test case 1: exponential to sin
+    f1 = 1 / 2 * (-I*exp(I*k) + I*exp(-I*k))
+    assert trigsimp(f1) == sin(k)
+    
+    # Test case 2: exponential to sinc
+    f2 = 1 / 2 / k * (-I*exp(I*k) + I*exp(-I*k))
+    assert trigsimp(f2) == sinc(k)
